tools.name: opcua_get_live_tag_value
tools.description: Retrieve the current value of a live OPC-UA tag (vibration, temperature, pressure, current, or digital alarm) for an equipment. Read-only; this connector never writes setpoints or control values back to PLCs.

equipment_id.description: SAP PM equipment ID mapped from the tag-to-asset mapping table.

tools.name: opcua_get_tag_history
tools.description: Retrieve historical values for one or more OPC-UA tags over a time window via the HistoryRead service, for backfill and model training data.

tools.name: opcua_subscribe_tags
tools.description: Create or update a real-time publish/subscribe subscription for a list of OPC-UA tags at a given sampling interval, so new values stream to the SQL staging layer as they arrive.

tools.name: opcua_get_tag_asset_mapping
tools.description: Retrieve the tag-to-Equipment-ID mapping table entry for a given OPC-UA tag path or SAP PM equipment ID, used to contextualize raw tag names against maintenance-domain assets.
